editorial: Ever wonder what happens when a brilliant scientist lets his ambition override morality? In the dark superhero thriller Morbius, you’ll feel the weight of his obsession as he battles a rare blood disorder. The film diverges from typical comic‑book fare, treating the resurrection experiment like a classic horror lab scene that keeps you on edge. Joaquin Phoenix delivers a brooding, almost silent performance that anchors the nightmarish tone. Still, the mid‑movie pacing meanders, leaving you craving more momentum toward the finale. But if you thrive in unsettling science‑driven narratives, this cinematic walk into darkness will surprise you.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of dark, late‑night thrills who crave a sci‑fi set‑up with a tragic hero.
